messages:
alex: heads up — vendor emailed: APAC (australia-southeast1) rack inbound is delayed ~72h. we have a customer demo next Tue that needs GPUs. can infra confirm if we can cover 2h of live traffic with 4 h100s or 8 a100s? also need quota checks across clouds. who’s around to triage?
jamal: I’m online. will check AWS/GCP quotas now and see if we can burst into our partner account. running quick quota list: `gcloud compute regions describe australia-southeast1 --format='value(quotas)'` and `aws ec2 describe-instance-type-offerings --filters Name=location,Values=ap-southeast-2`. will post numbers in 10m. :mag_right:
leah: tagging dedicated pool owners — if we can’t get cloud quota we could temporarily reassign 4 slots from the eu-dedicated pool for the demo (lower latency is fine for demo). need approval from product/ops? :thinking_face:
maria: product is ok with demo using smaller batch sizes if needed, but customer wants near real-time. can we also try ephemeral spot H100s from kevin-vendor? he mentioned holdback capacity.
kevin-vendor: hi all — we can gate up to 6 h100s for a 4-hour window as an emergency loan if your procurement approves a short form. ETA to spin: ~45 minutes once we get sign-off. will bill as usage + a 1-hour minimum. ping me with the timeslot.
oncall-bot: Incident: capacity-alert — ap-southeast-2 reported decreased available gpus at 2024-11-12T09:12:00Z. See /ops/capacity for details. :warning:
jamal: quotas: GCP a100 regional quota available = 12, but per-project a100 vCPU quotas near limit for our demo project; AWS has a100-backed instances available but account-level soft-limit of 8. Partner account (kevin) shows 10 available h100s. TL;DR: we can cobble together 8 a100s between GCP+AWS with config churn, or accept 6 h100s from vendor.
ale x: thanks. two asks: 1) can procurement greenlight vendor short-form for 6 h100s if we need the lower-latency option? 2) can eng run a small canary deploy to verify the demo path by Mon evening?
procurement-bot: Created ticket PR-4321: "Vendor emergency loan approval - kevin-vendor - 6 h100s". Approvers: @maria, @leah. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PR-4321
maria: +1 to emergency loan if cost is communicated. please include estimated delta in ticket (~$3k for the window?)
leah: +1 from me too for the loan. I’ll also open a reassign request to move 4 slots from eu-dedicated to the demo pool if partner falls through.
jamal: action items: 1) kevin - hold the 6 h100s until we confirm (kevin: ack?) 2) infra (me + alex) will run quota/instance prep and a canary deploy Mon 18:00 UTC 3) procurement will finalize PR-4321
kevin-vendor: ack, holding 6 h100s on standby. please confirm by Mon 17:30 UTC or we release.
alex: thanks — I’ll message product and the customer about plan B (partner h100 loan) and keep the demo at reduced concurrency if we end up with mixed a100/h100 pool. posting canary checklist in /eng-infra tomorrow. :thumbsup:
